title: Ashbury Rewards Brand Standards Schedule: Relocation Brand Supplement
content:
**Ashbury Rewards — relocation brand supplement.** A relocated reservation at an Ashbury Reserve or Ashbury Resort & Spa hotel carries a relocation brand supplement of five thousand points, one at an Ashbury Grand or Ashbury Hotel carries two thousand five hundred points, and one at an Ashbury Express or Ashbury Inn & Suites hotel carries none. The supplement is added to the relocation compensation of that reservation. The brand is the hotel brand recorded on the relocated reservation's Room Reservations record.

| Brand of the relocated reservation | Relocation brand supplement |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Reserve | 5000 points |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | 5000 points |
| Ashbury Grand | 2500 points |
| Ashbury Hotel | 2500 points |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | None |
| Ashbury Express | None |

The supplement depends on the brand alone: the tier, the nights and the channel do not change it.

**Illustration (hypothetical reservations).** A member relocated from an Ashbury Resort & Spa carries a brand supplement of 5000 points; the same member relocated from an Ashbury Express carries none.
